description.narrative: The proposed $75 million investment in Creador VI, L.P., a targeted $750 million regional private equity fund, will enable ADB to contribute growth capital to companies operating in the business services, consumer, health care, financial services, and manufacturing sectors. The fund will invest in businesses with significant business operations in India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, and Viet Nam.
